Package logic

Class ReportRequest

java.lang.Object
logic.ReportRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ReportRequest extends Object implements Serializable
request payload for the three monthly report queries.

carries the report period (year + month) and an optional park filter. sent by the client as the data payload of GET_VISITOR_REPORT, GET_CANCEL_REPORT, and GET_USAGE_REPORT messages.
